reason: The matrix error norm formed sqrt(sum(abs(ball)^2)); for balls containing zero the Arb representational lower endpoint could be negative, and sqrt returned nan. The report nevertheless set complete=true. Its time coefficient errors and final transfer error are nonfinite, so it proves no local transfer error.
correction: Square each finite nonnegative absolute upper bound before summing; reject nonfinite fee records and JSON NaN. Run a new actual local-flow computation.
preserved_scope: The separate outer-domain report of run43303238218 used the scalar accretive formula and contains finite bounds; it is not invalidated by this local norm bug.
